action_summary: Removed all six destructive fold-checkpoint deletion commands so the existing BiEncoderEvaluator can use the full copied fold ensemble. This restores the model membership of v16, which scored 0.38513 versus v17 at 0.37427, while preserving sigmoid blending, the experiment, Kaggle paths, batch size, notebook cell structure, and submission generation. Kept the change isolated because no local validation data are available; no training or inference was run and a score improvement is not guaranteed.
